headline.en: Turn a missing skill into a tested artifact.
headline.zh: 把缺少的 Skill 变成可测试的产物。

sub.en: capforge turns an explicit task and example inputs into a candidate skill, runs its assertions, and signs successful results with local provenance.
sub.zh: capforge 根据明确任务与示例输入生成候选 Skill，执行断言，并为成功结果签名、记录来源。

body.en: Assertions give the generated skill a concrete acceptance condition.
body.zh: 断言为生成 Skill 提供具体验收条件。

body.en: Signed records include task, synthesis and test information.
body.zh: 签名记录包含任务、生成和测试信息。

body.en: The mock synthesizer needs no API key.
body.zh: mock 生成器无需 API 密钥。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Run the shipped slugify task through the offline mock, real shell assertions and signature verification. No model key is required.
note.zh: 使用随仓 slugify 任务运行离线 mock、真实 Shell 断言和签名校验，无需模型密钥。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Deterministic mock synthesis of the shipped slugify task, real shell assertions and Ed25519 signature verification; no model API is called.
steps.output:
{
  "goal": "slugify a string",
  "inputs": [
    "Hello World",
    "Foo Bar Baz!",
    "Café Résumé"
  ],
  "test_pass": true,
  "signed": true,
  "signature_valid": true,
  "model": "capforge-mock"
}

body.en: Run the shipped slugify task through the offline mock, real shell assertions and signature verification. No model key is required.
body.zh: 使用随仓 slugify 任务运行离线 mock、真实 Shell 断言和签名校验，无需模型密钥。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/capforge.git
cd capforge
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: The recorded demo uses deterministic mock synthesis. It proves the local test/sign/verify path, not model quality.
limitations.zh: 记录示例使用确定性 mock 生成，验证本地测试、签名和验签链路，不代表模型生成质量。

limitations.en: A temporary working directory and timeout are not an OS security sandbox. Review generated shell code and assertions before running them.
limitations.zh: 临时目录与超时不等同于操作系统安全沙箱；运行前应检查生成的 Shell 与断言。

limitations.en: A valid signature establishes integrity relative to its key, not the safety or usefulness of a skill.
limitations.zh: 有效签名说明产物相对密钥的完整性，不证明 Skill 安全或有用。

body.en: A skill library can miss the task in front of you. Describe that task with examples and an assertion so a new candidate has something concrete to satisfy before promotion.
body.zh: 现有 Skill 库未必覆盖眼前的任务。把任务、示例与断言写清楚，新的候选 Skill 就有了进入正式库之前必须满足的条件。

body.en: intake validates the task schema; synthesize creates a skill through an explicit provider or offline mock; the test runner executes example assertions in a temporary directory. Successful records are Ed25519-signed and saved to the local store. verify checks the persisted artifact; promote copies an accepted skill to the configured target.
body.zh: intake 校验任务结构；synthesize 通过指定模型提供方或离线 mock 生成 Skill；测试器在临时目录运行示例断言。成功记录经过 Ed25519 签名后保存到本地库，verify 检查已有产物，promote 将通过的 Skill 复制到配置目标。

body.en: intake validates the task schema; synthesize creates a skill through an explicit provider or offline mock; the test runner executes example assertions in a temporary directory. Successful records are Ed25519-signed and saved to the local store. verify checks the persisted artifact; promote copies an accepted skill to the configured target.
body.zh: intake 校验任务结构；synthesize 通过指定模型提供方或离线 mock 生成 Skill；测试器在临时目录运行示例断言。成功记录经过 Ed25519 签名后保存到本地库，verify 检查已有产物，promote 将通过的 Skill 复制到配置目标。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: CAPFORGE_HOME selects the store, keypair and config directory. CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR selects the promotion target. provider/model configure online synthesis; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY is read only when using that provider. The demo uses a temporary store and cleans up its own files.
body.zh: CAPFORGE_HOME 指定库、密钥和配置目录；CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR 指定推广目标。provider/model 控制在线生成；使用相应提供方时读取 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 或 OPENAI_API_KEY。示例使用临时库并清理自身文件。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
node dist/index.js forge --task examples/task-slugify.json --mock
node dist/index.js list
node dist/index.js verify <id>
node dist/index.js promote <id>
node dist/index.js ui
